description: This file contains factory functions to generate various request payloads for testing different API endpoints and validation scenarios within a FastAPI-based project. It provides functions to create valid and invalid submission requests, validation run requests, approval decision requests, and publish requests, all adhering to OpenAPI specifications.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] make_valid_draft_submission_request( *, dataset_uri: str = "s3://mock-bucket/datasets/dp1/v1.parquet", checksum_sha256: str = "a" * 64, classification: str = "Internal", schema_version: str = "1.2.0", max_age_seconds: int = 86400, submission_channel: str = "API", )
methods.description: Creates a valid DraftSubmissionRequest payload with default values for dataset reference, metadata, and submission channel.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] make_missing_metadata_submission_request()
methods.description: Creates an invalid submission payload missing mandatory metadata fields to test validation errors.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] make_validation_run_request(*, full_suite: bool = True)
methods.description: Produces a payload to trigger a validation run, with an option to run the full suite.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] make_approval_decision_request( *, decision: str = "APPROVE", report_version: str = "v1.0", rationale: str = "Looks good.", reauth_performed: bool = True, )
methods.description: Generates an approval decision payload including decision details, rationale, and reauthentication info.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] make_publish_request(*, target_version: str = "v1.0")
methods.description: Creates a payload to publish a draft with a specified target version.
